limits: Only the pinned current static main.js terrain and mean-sea zero surface. Arbitrary callbacks need a separate explicit contract.
Does not include animated wave crests, firework quenching, terrain collision response, smoke/material changes, renderer or GPU acceptance.
Region classification requires a conservative complete horizontal trajectory enclosure; endpoints alone are insufficient.
